entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
(The Beloved Prophet) frowned and turned away.
Upon this; that the blind man who came to his august court.
And what do you know? He (i.e. the blind man - 'Abdullah Bin Umme Maktoom) may become pure (from his shortcomings).
Or that he may accept advice, so that the advice may benefit him.
He who does not care (who thinks about himself being self-sufficient through wealth; such as Abu Jahl, Utbah and Umayyah, etc.).
You really pay attention to him.
And you have nothing to lose if he (i.e. the disbeliever) does not become pure.
And he who came to you running.
And he is fearing (Allah).
So, you leave him and are occupied elsewhere.
Not (to do) so; this (i.e. the Qur'aan) is really enlightenment.
So, whoever wishes to may memorise it.
(It is recorded) in those honourable scriptures.
(Which are) exalted, purified.
Written by the hands of such (angels).
Who are noble, righteous.
May (the disbelieving) man be destroyed; how ungrateful he is.
From what did He create him?
From a drop of liquid. He created him and then set various measures for him.
Then eased the way for him.
Then gave him death, then had him put in the grave.
Then, when He willed, He resurrected him.
Never! He (i.e. the disbeliever) has not yet completed what he was commanded (i.e. the acceptance of faith).
So, man should look at his food (as to how We produce it).
That We poured down water plenteously.
Then We split the earth thoroughly.
So caused the grain to grow therein.
And grapes and grass.
And olives and dates.
And dense gardens.
And fruits and grass.
For your benefit and for your cattle.
Then, when the deafening Scream will arrive.
On that Day, man will flee from his (own) brother.
And (from his) mother and father.
And from (his) wife and sons.
On that Day, each one has just one worry which is sufficient for him (of not caring about others).
Many faces will be shining on that Day.
Laughing, rejoicing.
And many faces will have dust upon them on that Day.
Darkness overcoming them.
It is they who are the disbelievers, the sinners.
